about: Expected answers of CCwiki's derivation engine on one wiki manifest and one curation. Written by scripts/derivations_reference.py; spec in plans/derivations.md. Exact when manifestSHA256 matches the clone's .reductions/relations.json and curationSHA256 matches Resources/derivation-curation.json; otherwise only each record's `stable` fields, `invariants`, `sentinels` and `mutations` are asserted, and only while every count is within `tolerance` of `counts`.

assumes: DLOG hard in Z_p^* (p prime, g a generator)
public-key FE for P/poly that is single-key, sub-exponentially secure and weakly compact
DLOG hard in Z_p^* (p prime, g a generator)
DBDH in the same symmetric prime-order pairing group as DLIN
DLIN in the same symmetric prime-order pairing group as DBDH
